description: Free. ChainK9's latest stored verdict (danger, caution or ok) for a token on BNB Smart Chain, Ethereum, Base or Arc, with the names of the checks that failed or warned and when it was scanned. Most funded new launches are scanned within minutes. For the evidence behind each check use the paid report tool; for a fresh check use scan-lite, scan or scan-ultra.
name: verdict

plain.description: What each flagged check means for a holder, by check name

report_url.description: The token's public report page on chaink9.com, to cite

scanned_at.description: When the scan ran, RFC 3339 UTC

tier.description: lite, full, ultra or static (contract checks only, never traded)

verdict.description: danger: a check failed (for example the sell reverted); caution: a high or critical check warned; ok: no trap found; unknown: the scan could not decide

warned.description: High or critical checks that warned
